task.title: Wrap telemetry-ingest and lineage-read into deployable HTTP services
task.summary_zh: 替 telemetry-ingest 和 lineage-read 補 HTTP wrapper、Dockerfile、health endpoint 與 compose wiring。
acceptance: telemetry-ingest and lineage-read are deployable services with health surfaces
evidence services are wired into the target single-VM stack
task.next: Owner finalized approved task and closed it. Telemetry-ingest and lineage-read deployable HTTP service evidence is accepted and wired into compose.
review_notes_zh: 已審閱 telemetry-ingest/lineage-read HTTP surfaces、health endpoints 與 compose wiring；review 中補上 lineage-read script-mode/Docker entrypoint 的 repo root import 修正，避免 /workspace/services/lineage-read/main.py 直接啟動時找不到 services package。

驗證通過：python3 -m unittest services/lineage-read/test_main.py；python3 -m unittest services.telemetry.test_main_routes services.telemetry.lineage_read.test_service；docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config；docker compose -f docker-compose.control.yml config；另以 PORT=39094 timeout 3 python3 services/lineage-read/main.py 確認 server 可啟動並載入 corpus。

handoffs.message: Implemented deployable evidence HTTP surfaces: lineage-read now wraps the LIN-002 LineageReadService projection engine with health/readiness semantics and projection routes; compose wiring sets LINEAGE_READ_CORPUS_PATH. Verification: python3 -m unittest services/lineage-read/test_main.py; python3 -m unittest services.telemetry.test_main_routes services.telemetry.lineage_read.test_service; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config; docker compose -f docker-compose.control.yml config.
Review approved after fixing lineage-read direct-entry import path; HTTP surfaces, health routes, projection routes, and compose wiring verified. Owner should finalize to done.
